_note: Aishwarya Dental Clinic palette (25 Oct 2026), taken from her logo: the steel of the implant screw (primary), the graphite band and 'A' (text, footer), the silver-white enamel (tints), plus a champagne accent for calls to action that matches the 'premium' tagline and the walnut-and-marble interior. Champagne is a BACKGROUND colour only: text on it is always ctaInk (graphite). 'mint' keeps its key name for the shared components but is a silver tint here: decoration only on light backgrounds, as text only on graphite (mintOnDark). Colours become CSS variables (src/lib/theme.ts) and the ClinicFlow white-label theme tokens (npm run tenant). Run `npm run contrast` after any change.
